description: Land Acquisition - Algama & Nagane, Weerambugedara and Ogodapola D/S Division, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurnegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including lot numbers, boundaries, extents, and location descriptions. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, with no government personnel changes or structural modifications mentioned beyond the ministerial declaration authority.
